blocks.t: F I G U R E 17.34 Electrolytic refining of copper. Many slabs of impure copper (anodes) alternating with thin sheets of pure copper (cathodes) are immersed into a dilute acidic solution of CuSO4. Copper metal oxidized from the impure anodes enters the solution as Cu21 ions that migrate to the cathodes where they plate out as copper metal of higher purity.
